name: Jezebel
title: Daughter of Ethbaal and Queen of Ahab
summary: Jezebel was the daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon and became queen of Israel through her marriage to King Ahab. She is known for promoting Baal worship in Israel, persecuting the Lord's prophets, and her role in the murder of Naboth. Her name became synonymous with idolatry and evil in biblical tradition.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Ahab and the introduction of Baal worship
keyEvents.description: Jezebel married King Ahab of Israel and introduced large-scale Baal worship, including supporting 450 prophets of Baal and 400 prophets of Asherah.

keyEvents.title: Persecution of the Lord's Prophets
keyEvents.description: Jezebel sought to destroy the Lord's prophets. The godly Obadiah hid a hundred prophets in caves and provided for them to save them from her persecution.

keyEvents.title: The Threat Against Elijah After Carmel
keyEvents.description: After Elijah had defeated the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel, Jezebel sent a threat to kill him, causing the prophet to flee into the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: The Murder of Naboth and the Theft of His Vineyard
keyEvents.description: When Naboth refused to sell his vineyard to Ahab, Jezebel arranged for false witnesses and had Naboth stoned to death so that Ahab could take his vineyard.

keyEvents.title: Elijah's Judgment Against Jezebel
keyEvents.description: The Lord sent the prophet Elijah to announce judgment against Ahab and Jezebel for the murder of Naboth. Elijah prophesied that dogs would eat Jezebel's body by the wall of Jezreel.

keyEvents.title: Jezebel's Death at Jehu's Hand
keyEvents.description: When Jehu arrived in Jezreel, Jezebel adorned herself and stood at the window. At Jehu's command, courtiers threw her down from the window, and she was trampled by horses and eaten by dogs, fulfilling Elijah's prophecy.

keyEvents.title: Jezebel Mentioned as a Warning in Revelation
keyEvents.description: In the letter to the church in Thyatira, Jesus uses the name Jezebel to describe a false prophetess who led people into immorality and idol worship.
